rows.quote: The publicly available R10 data from the FinnGen study comprised 4620 patients with VTE and 356,574 healthy controls.[21] In contrast, the VTE-related GWAS data from the UK Biobank, obtained from Neale labs, consisted of 4620 cases and 356,574 controls, encompassing 11,901,177 SNPs, and utilizing the disease code ukb-d-I9_VTE (https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/).
rows.coder_note: Passage line states the R10 data from the FinnGen study were used; the same case and control counts are repeated for the UK Biobank data in that line, flagged for the checker.

The line attributes the UK Biobank GWAS to Neale labs while giving the id ukb-d-I9_VTE; in the dictionary the Neale lab alias and the ukb-d alias belong to different rows, and neither Neale round is named; flagged for adjudication.
